/industry-news/integrated-fire-pump-pack.name: Integrated Fire Pump Package with Electric Motor and Diesel Engine Backup
/industry-news/integrated-fire-pump-pack.body: With the continuous expansion of modern industrial facilities, high-rise buildings, large-scale warehousing centers, petrochemical projects, and infrastructure projects, fire safety has become a core aspect of project construction and operation management. As the power source for fire extinguishing systems, the reliability of the fire water supply system directly affects emergency response capabilities during a fire. Traditional single-power fire pumps pose certain risks in the face of power outages, equipment failures, or extreme environments. However, the integrated electric motor + diesel engine backup fire pump unit, through a dual-power redundancy design, integrates the electric fire pump and the diesel engine fire pump on the same system platform, achieving dual protection under normal power supply and power outage conditions, providing a continuous, stable, safe, and reliable fire water supply capacity for various critical locations.1. Dual-Power Redundancy Design Ensures Uninterrupted Fire Water SupplyThe most significant feature of the integrated electric motor + diesel engine backup fire pump unit is its dual-power configuration. The system typically uses the electric fire pump as the main operating equipment, undertaking daily fire water supply tasks under normal power supply conditions. In the event of a power outage, power line failure, or grid anomaly, the diesel engine fire pump can automatically start and quickly take over the water supply task. The dual-power design effectively avoids the fire risks caused by the failure of a single power source, significantly improving the overall reliability of the fire protection system. For petrochemical enterprises, airports, data centers, high-rise buildings, and important public facilities, a continuous and stable fire water supply is crucial, and the dual-power system is a vital guarantee for meeting this need. Automatic switching is achieved through an intelligent control system, completing the main/standby transition without manual intervention, thus ensuring the fire suppression system is always in optimal standby condition.2. High-performance fire pump structure achieves stable and efficient water supplyThe unit adopts advanced fluid dynamics design concepts, optimizing the impeller and pump body flow channel structure to improve hydraulic efficiency and reduce energy loss. The equipment can provide different flow rate and head configurations according to project requirements, meeting the needs of various applications such as automatic sprinkler systems, fire hydrant systems, water cannon fire suppression systems, and foam fire suppression systems. The pump operates smoothly with minimal vibration and can maintain stable pressure output for extended periods. In large industrial parks and high-rise building projects, even with multiple fire terminals activated simultaneously, the system can still guarantee sufficient flow and pressure, providing continuous water supply support for fire suppression operations. High-efficiency water supply not only improves fire suppression efficiency but also reduces energy waste and improves the overall economic efficiency of the system.3. Diesel Engine Backup Power System Ensures Continuous Operation in Extreme ConditionsThe diesel engine, as a backup power unit, is a crucial guarantee for the unit's response to emergencies. The equipment uses an industrial-grade heavy-duty diesel engine, characterized by rapid start-up, strong power, and outstanding continuous operation capability. Even in the event of a complete power outage, the diesel engine can still operate independently and drive the fire pump normally. The engine has undergone rigorous durability testing and can withstand high temperature, low temperature, high humidity, and complex environmental conditions. For high-risk locations such as oil tank areas, natural gas stations, and hazardous chemical warehouses, the diesel engine backup power can maintain the operation of the fire water supply system at the most critical moments, buying valuable time to control the fire and minimize losses.4. Intelligent Automatic Control System Improves Fire Response EfficiencyThe unit is equipped with an advanced intelligent control cabinet that can monitor system pressure, flow rate, voltage, current, engine status, and operating parameters in real time. When the fire pipeline pressure drops to the set value, the system automatically starts the main fire pump to supply water; if the main pump fails to start or the power supply is interrupted, the backup diesel engine unit automatically starts operation. The control system also has automatic testing, fault diagnosis, alarm prompts, and operation recording functions to help managers keep abreast of equipment status. Automated management reduces human error, improves fire response speed, and ensures equipment can be deployed immediately upon the occurrence of a fire.5. Simplified Installation and Construction with Integrated Skid-Mounted StructureThis unit adopts an integrated skid-mounted design concept, integrating the fire pump, diesel engine, electric motor, control system, piping components, and monitoring devices onto a unified base platform. Assembly and performance testing are completed before the equipment leaves the factory; on-site installation only requires piping and power connections for immediate use. Compared to traditional decentralized on-site installation methods, the integrated design significantly shortens the construction cycle, reduces installation costs, and improves project construction efficiency. Simultaneously, the overall structural layout is rational, facilitating later maintenance and management, and providing convenient conditions for project implementation.6. Long-Term Continuous Operation Capability Meets the Needs of Major FiresMajor fires often require prolonged and continuous firefighting, placing extremely high demands on the continuous operation capability of firefighting equipment. The unit adopts a heavy-duty industrial standard design, with key components reinforced for superior durability. An efficient cooling system keeps the diesel engine and electric motor operating within their optimal temperature range, preventing performance degradation due to overheating. A reinforced lubrication system reduces mechanical wear and extends equipment lifespan. Even under continuous high-load operation for dozens of hours, the unit maintains a stable water supply capacity, providing reliable support for large-scale fire fighting.7. Corrosion Resistance and Environmental Adaptability to Complex Working ConditionsIndustrial environments typically present adverse factors such as high temperature, high humidity, dust, and corrosive gases. Key components of the unit are manufactured using high-strength, corrosion-resistant materials, and the pump body and pipelines undergo special anti-corrosion treatment, effectively resisting external environmental erosion. The control cabinet has a high protection level, providing dustproof, waterproof, and moisture-proof protection. Whether in coastal areas, high-temperature industrial parks, or chemical production areas, the equipment maintains stable operation. Excellent environmental adaptability significantly extends equipment lifespan, reduces maintenance frequency, and lowers operating costs.8. Energy-Saving Operation Mode Reduces Long-Term Operating CostsIn normal standby mode, the system primarily relies on electric fire pumps, offering advantages such as low energy consumption, low operating costs, and easy maintenance. The diesel engine only starts in case of power outages or special emergencies, thus effectively reducing fuel consumption and equipment wear. High-efficiency motors and optimized pump design further improve energy utilization, achieving a balance between reliability and economy. For long-term industrial projects, this design significantly reduces lifecycle operating costs and increases return on investment.9. Widely Applicable to Various Fire Protection Engineering FieldsThe integrated electric motor + diesel engine backup fire pump unit is suitable for various fields including petrochemicals, power energy, steel metallurgy, ports and docks, airports, hospitals, data centers, commercial complexes, high-rise buildings, warehousing and logistics parks, and municipal fire protection engineering. In different application scenarios, the equipment can provide stable and reliable fire water supply. Its highly flexible configuration can be customized according to project scale and fire protection regulations, meeting various complex engineering needs and is an important component of modern fire protection engineering construction.10. In line with the intelligent development trend of modern fire protection systemsWith the development of smart fire protection and digital management technologies, fire protection equipment is upgrading towards intelligence. This unit supports remote monitoring, data acquisition, fault alarm, and network management functions, and can be linked with building fire protection management platforms. Managers can view the equipment's operating status in real time through monitoring terminals, promptly identify potential problems, and perform maintenance. Intelligent functions not only improve equipment management efficiency but also enhance the overall safety level of the fire protection system, providing a solid foundation for future smart fire protection construction.Integrated electric motor + diesel engine backup fire pump units, with their dual-power redundancy design, high-efficiency water supply capacity, intelligent automatic control, long-term continuous operation performance, corrosion-resistant structure, and wide range of applications, have become indispensable equipment in modern fire protection engineering. They can continuously provide a stable fire water supply under normal power supply and power outage conditions, building an all-weather fire safety barrier for industrial facilities, commercial buildings, and public infrastructure. With the continuous improvement of global fire safety standards and the ongoing development of smart fire protection technologies, this product will play an even more important role in the future of fire water supply, providing safer, more efficient, and more reliable fire protection solutions for various critical locations.

/industry-news/integrated-vertical-jocke.name: Integrated Vertical Jockey Fire Pump Units for Optimized Fire Water Management
/industry-news/integrated-vertical-jocke.body: Modern fire protection systems not only require fire pumps to be able to quickly deploy during a fire, but also demand that the entire fire protection piping network maintain stable pressure over the long term, ensuring the system is always in optimal standby condition. The integrated vertical pressure-stabilizing fire protection unit combines a vertical multi-stage pressure-stabilizing pump, intelligent control cabinet, pressure detection device, piping components, and base into one unit. It features automatic pressure stabilization, automatic water replenishment, intelligent monitoring, and energy-saving operation. It can be widely used in high-rise buildings, industrial plants, commercial complexes, hospitals, schools, data centers, airports, ports, and municipal fire protection projects, providing stable, efficient, and reliable pressure assurance for fixed fire water supply systems.1. Integrated Structure Improves Installation EfficiencyThe unit adopts a modular integrated design, integrating the pressure-stabilizing pump, control cabinet, valves, and piping into a common base. This facilitates transportation and simplifies on-site installation, effectively reducing construction time, improving project construction efficiency, and minimizing installation errors, ensuring rapid system commissioning.2. Vertical Multistage Pump Achieves High-Efficiency Pressure StabilizationThe equipment utilizes a high-efficiency vertical multistage centrifugal pump with an optimized hydraulic model, featuring high head, high efficiency, stable operation, and low vibration. It can continuously maintain stable pressure in the fire protection network, providing reliable pressure support for the entire fire protection system.3. Intelligent Control Enables Automatic Water ReplenishmentThe control system monitors real-time pressure changes in the fire protection network. When the pressure falls below the set value, the pressure-stabilizing pump automatically starts to replenish water, and automatically shuts down after the pressure recovers. No manual intervention is required, achieving 24/7 intelligent operation and improving the automation level of the fire protection system.4. Precise Pressure Control Reduces Main Pump Start-upThrough the collaborative work of a high-precision pressure sensor and intelligent control program, the equipment can precisely regulate the network pressure, avoiding frequent starts of the main fire pump due to minor leaks or natural pressure drops, effectively extending the service life of the main pump and related equipment.5. Energy-Saving Operation Reduces Maintenance CostsThe pressure-stabilizing pump only operates automatically when the pressure drops and automatically stops after reaching the set pressure, reducing ineffective energy consumption. Meanwhile, the motor boasts high efficiency, stable operation, and minimal wear, effectively reducing energy consumption and subsequent maintenance costs, thus improving overall economic benefits.6. Multiple Safety Protections Ensure Stable OperationThe equipment features multiple safety functions, including overload protection, phase loss protection, short circuit protection, overvoltage protection, undervoltage protection, and fault alarms. In case of abnormalities, it can promptly alarm and take protective measures, improving equipment operational safety and system reliability.7. Adaptable to Various Complex Application EnvironmentsThe unit can be configured with anti-corrosion materials, moisture-proof design, and special electrical control schemes according to different engineering environments. It can adapt to high temperature, high humidity, coastal, low temperature, and industrial corrosive environments, maintaining long-term stable operation under various complex working conditions.8. Convenient Maintenance Improves Operating EfficiencyThe overall layout is scientifically and rationally designed. Sufficient maintenance space is reserved for the control cabinet, pressure stabilizing pump, and valves, making daily inspections, maintenance, and parts replacement more convenient, helping to shorten downtime and improve long-term equipment operating efficiency.9. Widely Applicable to Various Fire Protection ProjectsThe product is suitable for fire water supply systems in high-rise residential buildings, office buildings, commercial complexes, hospitals, schools, stadiums, industrial plants, petrochemical plants, power facilities, airports, ports, warehousing and logistics, rail transit, and data centers, providing stable pressure assurance for different projects.10. Supports Multiple Customized ConfigurationsBased on different fire protection standards and project requirements, different flow rates, head, control methods, and communication functions can be provided. It also supports remote monitoring, dual-pump backup, frequency conversion control, and multiple interface expansions to meet diverse fire protection engineering construction needs.The integrated vertical pressure-stabilized fire-fighting unit integrates a high-efficiency vertical multi-stage pump, intelligent control system, automatic water replenishment technology, and modular structure, possessing advantages such as stable pressure stabilization, automatic operation, energy saving and environmental protection, safety and reliability, and convenient maintenance. The product can continuously maintain the pressure of the fire pipeline network, reduce frequent starts of the main fire pump, improve the reliability and service life of the entire fire water supply system, and is suitable for various modern building and industrial fire protection projects. With its advanced automatic control capabilities, excellent environmental adaptability, and flexible customization options, it can provide long-term, stable, and efficient pressure maintenance solutions for fixed fire water supply systems, making it an indispensable piece of equipment in modern fire protection engineering.

/industry-news/intelligent-constant-pres.name: Intelligent Constant Pressure Fire Equipment for Efficient Fire Water Supply
/industry-news/intelligent-constant-pres.body: With the continuous expansion of modern building scale and the constant improvement of fire safety standards, fire water supply systems have become an indispensable and important component in high-rise buildings, commercial complexes, industrial parks, warehousing and logistics centers, and public facilities. In modern fire protection engineering, a stable and continuous water supply capacity is directly related to the efficiency of initial fire control and the reliability of the overall fire protection system. Traditional fire water supply equipment often suffers from problems such as large pressure fluctuations, high energy consumption, insufficient automation, and complex maintenance and management during operation, making it difficult to meet the demands of modern smart fire protection for high-efficiency, intelligent, and energy-saving operation. Against this market backdrop, intelligent constant pressure fire protection equipment, with its advantages of automatic constant pressure water supply, intelligent control, high-efficiency operation, and remote monitoring, has gradually become a core piece of equipment in modern fire protection engineering. This type of equipment can achieve stable pressure supply and rapid response under complex fire conditions, not only improving fire extinguishing efficiency but also effectively reducing long-term operating costs, providing a more reliable and intelligent guarantee for the fire safety of modern buildings.1. Intelligent Constant Pressure Technology Ensures Stable Operation of Fire Water SupplyThe biggest advantage of intelligent constant pressure fire protection equipment lies in its advanced constant pressure water supply capability. Traditional fire protection systems are prone to unstable water supply due to fluctuations in pipeline pressure, affecting the fire extinguishing effectiveness of sprinkler and fire hydrant systems. Intelligent constant-pressure equipment monitors real-time pressure changes in the fire protection pipeline network using pressure sensors and automatically adjusts pump operating speed in conjunction with an intelligent control system, ensuring a stable pressure supply throughout the entire fire protection system. When system pressure drops, the equipment can quickly increase output power, while automatically reducing operating intensity under low load conditions, thus achieving precise pressure supply. This constant-pressure operation mode effectively reduces water hammer and pipeline fluctuations, improving the safety and stability of the entire fire protection system.2. High-efficiency water supply capacity meets the needs of large-scale fire protection projectsModern large-scale buildings and industrial fire protection projects have increasingly higher requirements for water flow and pressure; therefore, fire protection equipment must have a powerful water delivery capacity. Intelligent constant-pressure fire protection equipment adopts high-efficiency centrifugal pump technology and optimized hydraulic model design, improving overall water delivery efficiency through high-performance impellers and low-resistance flow channel structures. The equipment can quickly establish fire pressure in a very short time and continuously deliver a stable water source to sprinkler systems, fire monitors, and fire hydrant systems. Even in complex environments such as high-rise buildings, underground spaces, and long-distance fire hydrant networks, it can maintain stable pressure output. This high-efficiency water supply performance effectively improves the initial fire suppression speed and provides a more reliable water supply guarantee for modern fire protection systems.3. Intelligent Automatic Control System Improves Fire Response EfficiencyIntelligent constant pressure fire protection equipment is equipped with an advanced automatic control system, enabling fully automatic operation and management. The system can monitor pressure, flow, current, voltage, and equipment operating status in real time. When the fire protection system detects a fire signal or a drop in pipeline pressure, the equipment can automatically and quickly start and enter a stable water supply state, completing the fire response task without manual intervention. Compared with traditional manual operation, the intelligent control system can significantly shorten the fire response time and improve fire suppression efficiency. At the same time, the equipment also has functions such as automatic inspection, fault alarm, and operation data recording, which can promptly detect potential faults and provide early warning, thereby improving the safety and reliability of the entire fire protection system.4. Energy-Saving Operation Mode Reduces Long-Term Operating CostsWith the continuous promotion of green building concepts, the energy-saving performance of fire protection equipment is receiving increasing attention. Intelligent constant-pressure fire-fighting equipment utilizes variable frequency control technology and high-efficiency energy-saving motors, automatically adjusting its operating power according to the actual load of the fire-fighting system. When the system is in standby or low-load mode, the equipment automatically reduces energy consumption, thereby reducing energy waste and lowering long-term operating costs. Compared to traditional constant-speed operating equipment, it is not only more energy-efficient but also reduces mechanical wear and heat generation, extending the overall equipment lifespan. This energy-saving operating mode not only helps users reduce electricity costs but also meets the requirements of modern green building and low-carbon fire protection engineering.5. Modular Structure Design Simplifies Installation and MaintenanceIntelligent constant-pressure fire-fighting equipment adopts a modular integrated structure design, centrally installing the fire pump, motor, control system, pressure stabilizing device, and auxiliary pipelines on a unified platform. Compared to traditional decentralized fire-fighting equipment, on-site installation is more convenient, effectively reducing construction time and labor costs. The equipment can be fully commissioned before leaving the factory, so users only need to complete the basic connections to put it into operation, significantly improving project construction efficiency. Simultaneously, the modular design facilitates later maintenance and repair, allowing maintenance personnel to quickly complete equipment inspections and parts replacement, thereby reducing downtime and maintenance costs.6. Remote Monitoring Enhances Smart Firefighting ManagementModern smart firefighting increasingly emphasizes equipment networking and digital management capabilities. Intelligent constant-pressure firefighting equipment supports remote monitoring and data networking, recording real-time equipment operating parameters, including pressure, flow rate, operating frequency, fault status, and energy consumption data. Managers can view equipment operation status anytime via computer or mobile terminal and promptly identify potential problems. The system also features remote alarm and remote maintenance functions, promptly notifying managers to handle abnormal situations. This digital management model not only reduces manual inspection workload but also improves fire management efficiency and system operational safety.7. Low-Noise and Low-Vibration Design Improves Operating EnvironmentTraditional firefighting equipment is prone to significant vibration and noise during operation, especially in high-rise buildings and commercial complexes, which can easily affect the surrounding environment. Intelligent constant-pressure firefighting equipment employs a vibration-damping base, flexible coupling, and optimized dynamic balance structure design, effectively reducing mechanical vibration and operating noise. The equipment operates more smoothly, reducing pipeline impact and mechanical wear, and improving overall equipment stability. This low-noise operation mode is particularly suitable for locations with high environmental requirements, such as hospitals, schools, hotels, high-end residences, and commercial centers, helping to improve the overall comfort of building use.8. High-Reliability Design Adapts to Complex Firefighting ConditionsFirefighting equipment must possess high reliability in critical moments; therefore, intelligent constant-pressure firefighting equipment adopts an industrial-grade structural design and high-quality core component manufacturing. Key components, including the pump body, pump shaft, mechanical seal, and control system, are all made of wear-resistant and corrosion-resistant materials and have undergone rigorous performance testing and durability verification. The system can operate stably for extended periods in high-temperature, high-humidity, and complex industrial environments, maintaining stable water supply performance even under high-load continuous operation. This high-reliability design effectively reduces equipment failure rates and improves the overall safety assurance capability of the fire protection system.9. Widely Applicable to Various Modern Firefighting Engineering ScenariosIntelligent constant-pressure firefighting equipment is widely used in fire protection projects for high-rise buildings, commercial complexes, industrial plants, warehousing and logistics centers, hospitals, airports, data centers, and underground engineering projects. In different application scenarios, the equipment can be flexibly configured according to actual needs, including customized designs for flow rate, head, control mode, and pressure stabilization system. This high adaptability can meet the stable water supply system requirements of fire protection projects of different scales and types, providing a more efficient and reliable fire protection solution for modern complex building environments.10. Smart Fire Protection Development Drives Intelligent Equipment UpgradesWith the continuous development of IoT, big data, and artificial intelligence technologies, intelligent constant pressure fire protection equipment will further upgrade towards digitalization and intelligence in the future. Future systems will not only be able to achieve automatic fault diagnosis and remote maintenance, but also optimize operating strategies through data analysis, improving energy efficiency and reducing maintenance costs. Combined with smart building and smart city platforms, intelligent constant pressure fire protection equipment will become an important component of modern digital fire protection systems, providing more intelligent, safe, and efficient water supply solutions for future fire protection projects.Overall, intelligent constant pressure fire protection equipment, with its stable pressure supply capacity, high-efficiency water supply performance, intelligent automatic control, and energy-saving operation advantages, has become one of the core equipment in modern fire protection projects. It can not only effectively improve the operating efficiency and fire extinguishing response speed of fire protection systems, but also reduce long-term operating costs and improve the overall fire safety level. With the continuous development of smart fire protection and green building concepts, intelligent constant pressure fire protection equipment will play a more important role in the future building fire protection market, providing more reliable, efficient and intelligent water supply for industrial, commercial and public building fire protection systems.

The impeller undergoes precision machining and dynamic balancing to reduce operating vibration, improve water delivery efficiency, and ensure stable pressure output and water supply capacity during long-term operation.4. It can operate stably under complex conditions such as high temperature, low temperature, high humidity, and dusty environments, meeting the fire protection application needs of different regions and industrial environments.9. Suitable for Large-Scale Fire Protection ProjectsThe product can be widely used in petrochemical plants, manufacturing plants, warehousing centers, airports, ports, rail transit, power facilities, commercial complexes, and municipal fire protection projects. It can also be integrated with electric fire pumps, voltage stabilizing equipment, and fire control systems to form a complete fire water supply solution.10. Reduced Life Cycle Operating CostsThe equipment adopts a high-efficiency power system and standardized component design, making maintenance convenient and parts replacement quick. Combined with intelligent monitoring and preventative maintenance, downtime is reduced, equipment lifespan is extended, and long-term operating and maintenance costs are effectively reduced.The intelligent diesel fire pump equipment, with its independent diesel power, automatic start, high-efficiency fire pump, intelligent control, remote monitoring, and comprehensive safety protection functions, provides a stable and reliable fire water supply guarantee for large-scale fire protection systems. Whether in industrial facilities, public buildings, or large infrastructure projects, this equipment can serve as a key fire water supply device, providing a solid guarantee for the safe and stable operation of the fire protection system.

/industry-news/intelligent-dual-power-fi.name: Intelligent Dual-Power Fire Water Supply Equipment for Stable Pressure Delivery
/industry-news/intelligent-dual-power-fi.body: In modern fire protection engineering, fire water supply systems not only require rapid start-up but also need to maintain stable pressure and reliable water supply under various complex operating conditions. Intelligent dual-power fire water supply equipment utilizes a combination of electric and diesel fire pumps, integrating the fire pumps, power system, intelligent control cabinet, piping components, and common base into one unit. It achieves automatic control, automatic switching, continuous pressure supply, and intelligent monitoring, and is widely used in fixed fire water supply systems in industrial plants, high-rise buildings, petrochemical plants, ports, power plants, airports, warehousing and logistics facilities, and municipal engineering projects, providing safe, efficient, and stable fire water supply for various key locations.1. Dual-Power Configuration Enhances Water Supply ReliabilityThe equipment adopts a dual-power design with both electric and diesel fire pumps. Under normal circumstances, the electric fire pump operates. When the mains power is abnormal or the main pump fails, the diesel fire pump automatically takes over the water supply, achieving seamless switching and effectively ensuring the continuous operation of the fire protection system, thus improving overall water supply reliability.2. High-efficiency fire pumps ensure stable pressure outputThe fire pumps utilize a high-efficiency centrifugal structure with optimized flow channel design. The impellers are precision-machined and balanced, featuring high flow rate, high head, high efficiency, and low vibration. This ensures stable pressure output under various fire-fighting conditions, meeting the continuous water supply needs of large-scale fire protection systems.3. Intelligent control enables automatic operationThe intelligent control cabinet monitors the fire pipeline pressure, equipment operating status, and power system parameters in real time. When the pressure drops below the set value or a fire signal is received, the system automatically starts the corresponding fire pump and performs automatic control, status display, fault alarm, and operation recording, improving fire response efficiency.4. Diesel power ensures emergency water supplyThe diesel power system operates independently, without relying on external power sources. Even in the event of a power outage or grid failure, the fire pumps can be quickly started to continuously supply water. The engine has ample power and high fuel efficiency, meeting the needs of prolonged fire-fighting operations and providing reliable protection for critical locations.5. More Precise Automatic Pressure ControlThe system combines pressure sensors and intelligent control algorithms to monitor and automatically adjust the pressure of the fire-fighting pipeline network in real time. It automatically starts or stops equipment based on actual water demand, ensuring the entire fire-fighting water supply system maintains stable pressure, improving operational efficiency and reducing energy consumption.6. Multiple Protections Enhance Operational SafetyThe equipment is equipped with multiple protection functions, including protection against low oil pressure, high water temperature, overspeed, start-up failure, battery abnormality, insufficient fuel, and overload. When the system detects an abnormality, it immediately alarms and executes protective measures, effectively reducing the risk of equipment damage and ensuring the safe operation of the fire-fighting system.7. Integrated Structure Facilitates Installation and MaintenanceThe entire system adopts a modular common base design, with the diesel engine, fire pump, control cabinet, and piping centrally arranged. The compact structure and small footprint make transportation, hoisting, and on-site installation more convenient, while also providing ample maintenance space for future upkeep and repair.8. Adaptable to Diverse and Complex Operating EnvironmentsThe equipment can be configured with anti-corrosion treatment, cold-weather start-up devices, high-temperature heat dissipation systems, and high-altitude operation schemes according to different regions. It can maintain stable operation in coastal, high-temperature, high-humidity, cold, and dusty environments, meeting the diverse fire protection engineering application needs worldwide.9. Applicable to Multiple Fields of Fire Protection EngineeringThe product is widely used in petrochemical, energy and power, industrial manufacturing, ports and docks, airports, hospitals, schools, commercial complexes, high-rise buildings, data centers, warehousing and logistics, and municipal fire protection engineering, meeting the construction requirements of various fixed fire water supply systems.10. Flexible Configuration to Meet Customized Engineering NeedsThe equipment supports customization of different flow rates, heads, control methods, and interface specifications. Optional accessories include pressure-stabilizing pumps, pressure tanks, remote monitoring modules, automatic water replenishment systems, and flow testing devices, providing more comprehensive and flexible water supply solutions for fire protection projects of different scales.The intelligent dual-power fire water supply equipment integrates diesel power, electric fire pumps, high-efficiency centrifugal pumps, intelligent control systems, and automatic pressure management technology, possessing advantages such as automatic switching, continuous water supply, stable pressure, efficient operation, and multiple safety protections. The product can adapt to various complex working conditions and the needs of key fire protection sites. While ensuring the continuity of fire water supply, it improves the level of system automation management and operational reliability. It is an important piece of equipment for the construction of modern fixed fire water supply systems, providing long-term, stable, safe and efficient fire water supply solutions for industrial, municipal and building fire protection projects.

/industry-news/all-weather-reliability-c.name: All-Weather Reliability: Critical Role of Diesel Fire Pumps in Off-Grid Settings
/industry-news/all-weather-reliability-c.body: In fire safety systems across high-risk industrial sites, urban infrastructure, and remote areas, the reliability of power supply remains a critical consideration. Especially in emergency situations caused by natural disasters, power grid failures, or sudden accidents leading to power outages, ensuring the continuous operation of fire safety systems becomes the key factor determining personnel safety and asset protection. Diesel fire pump sets, with their ability to operate independently of the power grid, serve as the backbone for maintaining firefighting capabilities in power-outage environments. They not only offer robust power output but also integrate multiple technological advantages such as intelligent control, efficient combustion, and compact design, making them an indispensable core component of modern fire safety systems. This article will delve into the critical role of diesel fire pump sets in power-outage environments from ten perspectives, providing a comprehensive analysis of their performance advantages and application value.1. Independent power supply design ensures uninterrupted water supply during critical momentsThe core advantage of diesel fire pump sets lies in their ability to start and operate independently without relying on external power sources. This feature enables them to provide stable high-pressure water supply even during power outages, natural disasters, or failures in municipal power systems. Whether it is a sudden fire in an industrial zone or a fire accident in complex environments such as high-rise buildings, tunnels, or underground garages, the diesel engine as the power source can respond immediately, effectively ensuring the continuous and efficient operation of the fire protection system. By equipping high-capacity batteries, intelligent automatic start systems, and fuel reserve systems, the diesel pump set can automatically start and begin operation within seconds, ensuring that the fire protection system does not fail due to power outages.2. High-performance engines provide strong power outputThe high-performance engines in diesel fire pump sets can operate continuously and stably under various extreme conditions, delivering powerful output to meet the dual demands of flow rate and head in large-scale fire suppression systems. These engines are designed with industrial-grade specifications, featuring excellent thermal stability and high-temperature resistance, ensuring reliable performance even during prolonged high-load operations. With high combustion efficiency and rapid power response, they are compatible with various pump types and control systems, providing robust water supply support for complex fire scenarios.3. Wide adaptability to various application environmentsDiesel pump sets are designed to accommodate a wide range of application scenarios, including high-rise buildings, airports, petrochemical industries, warehousing and logistics, forest fire prevention, and rural waterworks. Particularly in environments without a stable power grid, such as construction sites, remote oil fields, and mountainous industrial and mining areas, diesel pump sets can be flexibly deployed to provide on-site water supply, significantly enhancing the flexibility and practicality of system deployment.4. Intelligent control systems enhance operational convenienceModern diesel fire pumps are widely integrated with intelligent features such as PLC control systems, automatic inspection, remote start, and fault alarms, enabling end-to-end digital management from local operations to remote monitoring. Users can monitor critical data such as pump set operating status, fuel levels, and alarm information in real-time via mobile apps or central control systems, ensuring efficient control without requiring operators to enter hazardous areas.5. Compact structure facilitates rapid deployment and maintenanceDiesel fire pump sets adopt a modular and compact design, occupying a small footprint and enabling quick installation and commissioning. They can be directly integrated into pump rooms, mobile pump trucks, or containerized systems. Their piping interfaces are highly standardized, facilitating rapid connection to on-site fire protection networks. In terms of maintenance, component replacement is simple, and inspection interfaces are well-equipped, reducing post-installation maintenance costs and complexity.6. High fuel efficiency and low emissions balance environmental protection and performanceThe latest generation of diesel fire pump sets incorporates high-pressure common rail fuel systems, low-carbon exhaust technologies, and intelligent combustion control devices. These advancements significantly improve fuel efficiency while reducing emissions and noise pollution, meeting both urban construction and industrial environmental standards. Especially in long-term operation scenarios, excellent fuel efficiency translates to lower operating costs and reduced fuel replenishment frequency.7. Strong environmental adaptability ensures stable equipment operationDiesel pump sets are designed to withstand harsh environmental conditions such as high temperatures, high humidity, extreme cold, and high dust levels. They feature freeze protection, shock resistance, corrosion protection, and dustproofing capabilities, ensuring stable operation in extreme climates such as deserts, coastal areas, and mountainous regions. Some products can also be equipped with optional soundproof enclosures, explosion-proof devices, and external protective cases to further enhance their all-weather deployment capabilities.8. Self-diagnosis and multiple protections ensure safe operationThe system is equipped with multiple safety protection functions, such as low oil pressure alerts, high water temperature alarms, overload protection, and low-fuel warnings. When the pump set encounters abnormalities during operation, it automatically triggers alarms and halts operation to prevent equipment damage and safety incidents. The system's self-diagnosis function automatically monitors critical parameters, ensuring it remains operational even after prolonged periods of inactivity.9. Support for multi-pump interlocking and emergency switching functionsTo enhance overall system reliability, diesel pump sets can be integrated with electric pumps and jockey pumps to form dual or multi-pump water supply systems. In the event of a main power pump failure or grid outage, the diesel pump set can automatically take over the water supply task without manual intervention, significantly improving emergency response speed and avoiding the risks associated with interrupted firefighting water supply.10. Long service life and significant lifecycle cost advantagesThe diesel fire pump set features a robust and durable construction, utilizing industrial-grade engines and high-strength pump body materials, enabling tens of thousands of hours of continuous operation without failure. Combined with its high reliability and low maintenance frequency, the diesel pump set offers a clear cost-effectiveness advantage over its entire lifecycle, making it a long-term solution with a high return on investment.In the face of emergency challenges in power-outage environments, diesel fire pump sets leverage their comprehensive advantages of independent operation, efficient output, intelligent control, and broad compatibility to establish a robust fire safety barrier. They not only resolve emergency water supply challenges in scenarios with unstable power supply but also demonstrate irreplaceable value in enhancing overall system resilience and response efficiency. In the future, with the integration of smart fire protection and green energy, diesel pump sets will continue to provide all-weather, all-scenario fire protection solutions for various industries in a more environmentally friendly and intelligent manner.

/industry-news/application-prospects-of-.name: Application Prospects of Twin Electric Fire Pump Equipment in Municipal and Industrial Fire Protection Systems
/industry-news/application-prospects-of-.body: With the acceleration of urbanization and the continuous rise of industrialization, fire safety has become increasingly important. Whether in municipal projects, industrial plants, or large complexes, strict requirements are placed on the stability and efficiency of fire water supply systems. Among the various firefighting equipment, dual electric fire pumps, due to their high efficiency, redundancy, and stability, have gradually become a key feature of municipal and industrial firefighting systems.1. Structure and Design Features of Dual Electric Fire PumpsDual electric fire pumps typically consist of two vertical or horizontal electric pumps installed in parallel, forming a "one primary, one backup" or "dual-pump parallel" configuration. The core design principle of this system is to enhance the system's water supply capacity through dual pump collaboration and ensure seamless takeover if either pump fails, thereby maintaining stable firefighting system operation. Structurally, this system typically utilizes multi-stage vertical pumps or high-efficiency centrifugal pumps, coupled with an intelligent control cabinet for automatic switching and remote monitoring. Its compact design is suitable for space-constrained pump rooms and is particularly well-suited for centralized installation in high-rise buildings and industrial plants.2. Dual Electric Drive ReliabilityCompared to single electric pump systems, dual electric fire pumps offer significantly improved reliability through their "double insurance" design. In municipal water supply and industrial production scenarios, fire protection systems must maintain uninterrupted standby throughout the year. In the event of a fire, the equipment must provide stable water pressure within a short period of time. Dual electric pumps can automatically or manually switch between them during operation. If the primary pump shuts down due to electrical failure or mechanical damage, the backup pump can immediately take over, effectively preventing system downtime caused by a single point of failure. This highly reliable configuration provides stronger fire safety protection for large public facilities and manufacturing enterprises.3. High Energy Efficiency and Energy Saving AdvantagesWith the growing adoption of green energy conservation concepts, the energy-saving advantages of dual electric fire pumps are becoming increasingly prominent. These systems can adjust their operating mode based on water demand. When water demand is low, only one pump is activated; when demand is high, both pumps operate in parallel, reducing energy consumption. Furthermore, electric motor drive offers lower noise levels and more manageable operating costs compared to diesel drives, meeting modern energy conservation and environmental standards. Some units are also equipped with a variable frequency control system, which ensures constant water pressure and avoids energy waste caused by frequent starts and stops. For municipal projects and industrial enterprises, this energy-efficient and efficient equipment not only reduces operating costs but also complies with sustainable development policies.4. Automated Control and Intelligent ApplicationsThe dual electric fire pump system is equipped with an advanced intelligent control cabinet, enabling fully automatic pump start and stop, fault alarms, and remote monitoring. Municipal water supply networks and industrial fire protection pipe networks are often widely distributed and complex, making manual monitoring limited. Intelligent control systems collect real-time operating data to dynamically monitor the pump current, voltage, and water pressure. If an abnormality occurs, the system automatically switches pumps and issues an alarm. Furthermore, some intelligent systems can be connected to fire control centers via IoT platforms, enabling remote operation and maintenance. This intelligent functionality significantly enhances the controllability and safety of the equipment.5. Application Value in Municipal Fire Protection SystemsDual electric fire pumps play a vital role in municipal fire protection systems. While urban pipe networks provide basic water supply, they often experience insufficient water pressure during peak fire seasons, especially in high-rise residential areas and large public buildings. This necessitates the use of independent fire pumps to ensure a stable water supply. Dual electric pumps not only meet high-flow, long-term water supply needs but also effectively mitigate system risks caused by power fluctuations. The redundancy and stability of this equipment are particularly important for municipal projects such as urban fire stations, public facilities, and underground integrated pipeline corridors.6. Application Prospects in Industrial Firefighting SystemsIndustrial enterprises often carry flammable and explosive materials, placing higher demands on firefighting systems than in ordinary locations. Dual electric fire pumps are widely used in industrial firefighting, particularly in petrochemical plants, steel mills, power plants, and warehouses and logistics centers. Fires in these locations require large volumes of water at high pressures, and dual electric pumps can provide a continuous, high-pressure water supply within a short period of time. Furthermore, their redundant design ensures that even if one pump fails, the other can still operate normally, ensuring uninterrupted firefighting operations. This stable water supply provides a solid foundation for safe production in industrial enterprises.7. Space Utilization and Installation AdvantagesCompared to traditional single, large fire pumps, dual electric pump systems feature a modular design, allowing for a more compact layout, which is particularly advantageous in locations with limited pump room space. Dual pumps can be installed side by side or back-to-back. Combined with an intelligent control system, they simplify complex piping and facilitate installation. Furthermore, the electric drive eliminates the need for additional fuel storage and exhaust facilities, reducing installation complexity and maintenance costs. This high space utilization and easy installation make them highly suitable for urban underground pump rooms, commercial complexes, and renovation projects.8. Easy Maintenance and Long Service LifeDual electric fire pumps offer exceptional maintenance performance. The motor's relatively simple structure, fewer wearing parts, and low vibration and noise during operation contribute to long maintenance cycles and low maintenance costs. The intelligent control system monitors the equipment's operating status in real time, providing early warning of potential failures and enabling maintenance personnel to conduct timely repairs. Alternating operation of the two pumps effectively distributes the workload, extending the overall equipment lifespan. For municipal and industrial organizations, this low-maintenance, high-durability feature undoubtedly reduces operating expenses.9. Compliance with International Standards and Safety CertificationsModern fire pump equipment typically adheres to strict international and regional fire protection standards, such as NFPA, EN12845, and ISO. Dual electric fire pumps, with their stable performance and rigorous testing processes, meet multiple international certification requirements, ensuring compliance across various countries and regions. For engineering projects or multinational corporations that require export, choosing a dual electric pump that meets international standards not only enhances the safety level of the fire protection system but also ensures smooth project acceptance. This is a key reason for their widespread popularity in the global market.10. Future Development Trends and Market PotentialWith the accelerated development of smart cities and smart factories, intelligent and integrated fire pump equipment will become a future trend. Dual electric fire pumps, with their advantages of high efficiency, energy saving, redundancy, and intelligent control, are poised for continued strong growth in the future market. The increasing demand for highly reliable fire water supply in municipal projects and the increasing reliance on high-pressure, high-flow water supply in the industrial sector provide broad opportunities for the development of dual electric pumps. With the further application of technologies such as the Internet of Things and big data, this equipment will demonstrate even greater potential in remote monitoring and predictive maintenance.Dual electric fire pumps, with their high energy efficiency, intelligent control, reliable redundancy, and convenient maintenance, have become a vital component of municipal and industrial fire protection systems. This equipment demonstrates irreplaceable value in both ensuring urban public safety and safeguarding industrial production safety. With the continuous improvement of fire safety requirements and the popularization of intelligent technology, dual electric fire pumps will play an even greater role in the future, contributing to the comprehensive upgrade of municipal and industrial fire protection systems.

/industry-news/automatic-diesel-fire-pum.name: Automatic Diesel Fire Pump Unit with Intelligent Control Panel
/industry-news/automatic-diesel-fire-pum.body:
In the ever-evolving field of fire protection, reliability, automation, and efficiency are paramount. Diesel fire pump units are widely used where electric power may be unstable or unavailable, providing a powerful and independent source of water pressure in critical moments. With the integration of advanced automation and intelligent control technology, today's diesel fire pumps offer unmatched reliability, real-time system diagnostics, and seamless operation during emergencies. This article introduces a cutting-edgeautomatic diesel fire pump unit equipped with an intelligent control panel, engineered to deliver consistent fire safety performance for a wide range of applications.

1. Advanced Automation for Immediate Response

One of the primary advantages of this diesel fire pump unit is its fully automated operational capability. Once triggered by a pressure drop or external fire alarm signal, the system initiates start-up procedures autonomously without human intervention. The automated start sequence ensures rapid deployment of the pump engine, reducing emergency response time and eliminating the need for manual monitoring during critical situations. Automation also extends to system testing and maintenance alerts, streamlining safety inspections and ensuring the pump is always ready to perform.

2. Intelligent Control Panel with Real-Time Monitoring

The integrated intelligent control panel is the core component of system management. Designed with a user-friendly interface, it offers real-time status updates, fault alerts, and engine diagnostics. Operators can monitor critical parameters such as engine temperature, oil pressure, battery voltage, and fuel levels. The panel also features alarm memory logs and data recording capabilities, which are essential for maintenance planning and regulatory compliance. Some models even support remote monitoring via Modbus or Ethernet communication protocols.

3. Diesel Engine with High Starting Torque

Equipped with a robust diesel engine, the fire pump ensures high starting torque and excellent load-handling capacity. This feature is crucial for reliable operation under varying environmental conditions, including low temperatures and high altitudes. The engine design includes features such as turbocharging, mechanical or electronic fuel injection, and automatic decompression. These improvements guarantee stable combustion and high efficiency while maintaining low fuel consumption and reduced emissions.

4. Wide Range of Flow and Pressure Configurations

To meet diverse project requirements, this diesel fire pump unit is available in a wide range of flow rates and pressure configurations. Whether installed in high-rise buildings, industrial complexes, or petroleum facilities, users can select the most appropriate model based on site-specific fire demand. Flow ranges typically span from 100 to 2000 GPM, with pressures exceeding 150 PSI. All performance data comply with NFPA-20 guidelines, ensuring consistent and certifiable performance across different applications.

5. High-Efficiency Pump End with Durable Components

The pump end is engineered for maximum hydraulic efficiency, minimizing energy loss and delivering consistent output even under extended operation. Constructed from corrosion-resistant materials such as cast iron, stainless steel, or bronze (depending on the application), it ensures long service life in aggressive water conditions. Impellers are dynamically balanced to reduce vibration and noise, contributing to smooth and quiet operation. The wear rings and shaft sleeves are easily replaceable, which facilitates routine maintenance and lowers life-cycle costs.

6. Compact Skid-Mounted Design for Easy Installation

This diesel fire pump unit is mounted on a heavy-duty steel skid, preassembled with the engine, pump, control cabinet, and auxiliary components such as fuel tank and battery box. The compact layout minimizes space requirements and simplifies installation, making it ideal for retrofit projects or locations with limited floor space. Lifting eyes and forklift pockets are integrated into the base frame for easy transportation and site positioning.

7. Comprehensive Safety and Protection Systems

Safety is paramount in fire pump operations. The unit includes multiple built-in protections such as low oil pressure shutdown, high engine temperature alarm, overspeed protection, and emergency stop switches. The intelligent control system continuously monitors these parameters, triggering alarms or shutdowns if anomalies are detected. Optional flameproof enclosures and spark arrestors can be added for hazardous or explosive environments, ensuring safe operation in compliance with international safety standards.

8. Independent Operation During Power Outages

As a diesel-powered system, this fire pump operates independently of the electric grid, providing uninterrupted fire protection during blackouts or grid instability. This makes it particularly suitable for high-risk environments such as chemical plants, remote industrial facilities, or areas prone to natural disasters. The self-contained nature of the unit—complete with its own fuel supply, battery start system, and control panel—ensures autonomy and reliability when it matters most.

9. Optional Accessories and System Customization

Users can select from a variety of accessories to enhance the system's functionality. Optional components include fuel level sensors, engine block heaters (for cold climates), remote monitoring modules, soundproof enclosures, and dual battery starting systems. The unit can also be customized to support dual pumps (duty + standby), jockey pumps, and full system integration with sprinklers or hydrants. This flexibility makes it adaptable to a wide range of technical specifications and site conditions.

10. Compliance with International Fire Safety Standards

This diesel fire pump unit is manufactured in accordance with major global standards such asNFPA 20,UL,FM, andEN12845(depending on model and configuration). It is suitable for use in applications requiring stringent fire protection compliance, including international building codes, insurance requirements, and audit protocols. Certificates of conformity, performance test reports, and factory inspection documents are available upon request to support engineering and tender documentation.

The automatic diesel fire pump unit with intelligent control panel represents the next generation of fire protection technology. Designed for high reliability, autonomous operation, and long-term durability, it delivers peace of mind in the most demanding fire safety applications. Whether for industrial facilities, commercial buildings, or remote infrastructures, this diesel fire pump system ensures fast response, dependable performance, and comprehensive fire safety—exactly when it’s needed most.

/industry-news/breaking-site-constraints.name: Breaking Site Constraints: Lightweight Design and Field Performance of Portable Diesel Pump Sets
/industry-news/breaking-site-constraints.body: In modern firefighting systems, as urban structures become increasingly complex and suburban areas continue to develop, there is a growing demand for emergency equipment that is flexible, mobile, and capable of responding efficiently. Portable diesel pump units, as firefighting equipment with independent power supply capabilities, compact structures, and ease of deployment, are increasingly becoming critical devices in emergency response scenarios such as outdoor emergencies, confined spaces, and remote areas. Their lightweight design not only significantly reduces transportation and operational difficulties but also demonstrates exceptional adaptability and stable performance in real-world scenarios, providing robust support for fire response in various special environments.1. Lightweight structural design for single-operator useOne of the core advantages of portable diesel pump units is their lightweight design. By optimizing the materials of the pump body, diesel engine frame, and support base, the overall weight of the unit is effectively controlled. The equipment generally uses aluminum alloy or high-strength composite metal materials, combining strength and toughness while reducing unnecessary redundant components. The compact layout structure allows the pump unit to be rapidly deployed by one or two people, greatly enhancing mobility and response efficiency in complex areas such as mountainous regions, rooftops, and forested areas.2. Diesel-driven, with strong self-powered capabilityThe equipment uses a diesel engine as its power core, eliminating reliance on external power sources, making it particularly suitable for emergency rescue tasks in power outage or low-power environments. The diesel engine starts quickly, fuel storage is convenient, and combustion efficiency is high, ensuring stable long-term operation of the pump unit. Additionally, the diesel engine has excellent adaptability to extreme environments such as high temperatures and high humidity, ensuring the equipment can operate normally under harsh weather conditions.3. High-efficiency pump body with strong water delivery capabilityThis series of portable pump units is equipped with high-performance single-stage or multi-stage centrifugal pump bodies, with flow rate and head designs compliant with fire industry standards, enabling rapid, high-flow water supply. The high-speed design drives the impeller to generate strong suction force, allowing the equipment to complete suction and pressurization in a short time, significantly reducing on-site water distribution time. This is crucial for initial fire suppression, where every second counts, helping to gain valuable time in controlling the fire.4. Compact structure, flexible installation optionsThe portable diesel pump set features a compact overall layout, with the base typically designed to be floor-mounted, wheeled, or portable, adapting to various operational scenarios. Its small footprint makes it particularly suitable for spaces with strict space requirements, such as basements, container-modified rooms, and mobile fire trucks, greatly enhancing deployment flexibility and meeting diverse emergency response needs.5. Easy maintenance ensures continuous operationIn firefighting operations, the ability of equipment to operate continuously is critical. This pump set was designed with ease of maintenance in mind, with all key maintenance components such as filters, oil ports, and pump shafts located in easily accessible areas. Routine maintenance can be performed without specialized tools, ensuring the equipment remains operational during prolonged use and significantly enhancing its reliability and operational effectiveness.6. Intelligent control system for enhanced user experienceAdvanced diesel pump sets are generally equipped with intelligent control panels that support one-button start, real-time parameter monitoring, and automatic alarm functions. Operators can view operational information such as RPM, pressure, fuel level, and battery status through a digital interface, enabling precise control and fault warnings. Some high-end models also support remote monitoring and data transmission, improving management efficiency in long-distance deployment scenarios.7. Adaptable to Multiple Operational EnvironmentsWhether in rural self-built homes, large industrial zones, oil field pipelines, or wilderness camps, portable diesel pump units can be rapidly deployed for operations. Their environmental adaptability surpasses that of conventional electric pump equipment. In emergency scenarios such as sudden floods, wildfires, or tunnel fires, they can respond and deploy swiftly, making them an ideal choice for firefighting teams, government emergency reserves, and corporate self-rescue systems.8. Strong fuel efficiency and low operating costsDiesel engines offer excellent fuel efficiency, consuming less fuel per unit of time compared to gasoline engines or electric-driven equipment, thereby reducing cost pressures during prolonged operation. Some models are equipped with large-capacity fuel tanks or auxiliary fueling systems, further extending the operational duration per use, making them suitable for high-intensity continuous use in emergency environments.9. /industry-news/centrifugal-pump-working-.body: Piston pumps,centrifugal pumpsand axial manner mode pump is common water pump. Piston pump is the use of atmospheric pressure, such as the common pressurized water machine. The centrifugal pump is the use of rotation of the impeller to drive the water to obtain a centrifugal force, the water raised to the height, but at the height of the centrifugal pump inlet, or restricted by atmospheric pressure. Axial flow pumps, fans and principles similar to the rotation of the blades, the water pump shaft is pushed backward direction. Axial flow pumps, but the lifting height (head) is not.A centrifugal pump1, also known as the pump casing, which is the main water pump. Fixed play a supporting role, and connected with the installation of the bearing bracket.2, the role of the pump shaft is connected by means of the coupling and the motor, the motor torque to pass the impeller, so it is the main component of transmitting mechanical energy.3, the bearing sleeve is supported on the shaft of the shaft member, there are two kinds of rolling bearings and plain bearings. Rolling refuel using butter as a lubricant should be appropriate generally much volume 2/3 to 3/4 may have a fever, there are too few sound and heat! Plain bearings using a transparent oil as lubricant, fuel oil level line. To much oil leaking along the shaft and drift *, too little bearing but also thermal burn caused by accident! Pump bearing temperature during operation up to 85 degrees in the general run of about 60 degrees, if necessary to find the cause of the high and timely manner!4, sealing ring, also known as Save drain ring. Too gap caused by the impeller inlet and the pump casing between the water pump high pressure area flows through the gap area of low pressure, affect the pump out water, reducing efficiency! Gap is too small will cause the impeller and pump casing friction wear. To increase the reflux resistance to reduce internal leakage, delay the impeller and the pump casing life with sealing ring in the pump casing and the impeller foreign aid junction edge seal gap is maintained between 0.25 ~ 1.10mm is appropriate.Centrifugal pumpworking principle is: relying on high-speed rotation of the impeller, the liquid in the centrifugal force of inertia in order to improve access to energy pressure. Pump before work, the body and into the water tank must be filled with water, to prevent the occurrence of cavitation. When the rapid rotation of the impeller blades to promote water quickly, the rotation of the water flew from the impeller in the centrifugal force, the water pump was thrown, the central portion of the impeller form a vacuum region. Water source at atmospheric pressure (or pressure) to the role of the pressure within the inlet pipe through the pipe network. This endless cycle, you can achieve continuous pumping.It is worth mentioning: it has to start before the centrifugal pump housing later filled with water before start, otherwise it will cause pump body heat, vibration, reducing the amount of water, damage to the pump cause equipment accident! The so-called cavitation means: start when the centrifugal pump, if the pump memory in the air, the air density is low, the centrifugal force produced by the rotation after a small, low-voltage and thus the formation of the central area of the impeller is not enough to level below the pump inlet the liquid suction pump, fluid can not transport phenomena.
